commit.message:
Reject reserved Serde JSON keys in code mode (#52681)

## Why

JavaScript objects containing Serde's reserved JSON keys can be reinterpreted during deserialization, allowing nested `RawValue` markers to bypass the parser's normal recursion limit.

## What changed

Reject `$serde_json::private::RawValue` and `$serde_json::private::Number` object keys before passing V8's serialized JSON to `serde_json`. Report a `reserved JSON object key` serialization error while continuing to allow marker text in strings and longer keys.

## Testing

Add runtime regression coverage for nested and escaped marker keys, recursion limits, normal JSON conversion, and session recovery without overwriting stored values. Extend the host-backed integration test to verify that stored values remain available across turns after rejection.

GitOrigin-RevId: 27ddce08e1ffe98ec9dffe02473a815ceae2cc89

Add timeout-aware exec-server configuration reads (#52679)

## Why

Remote configuration reads need a bounded wait without disrupting valid in-flight work on connections that cannot reconnect.

## What changed

- Add `read_environment_config_with_timeout` to `ExecServerClient` and `Environment`, bounding RPC sending and receiving after connection establishment. Local reads retain their existing behavior.
- Return a typed `ExecServerError::RpcTimedOut` and classify it as retryable for read-only preparation.
- Share timeout handling with environment-info requests. Close the timed-out transport and request recovery only when a reconnect strategy exists; otherwise, keep the connection open.

## Testing

Add a regression test verifying that a timed-out configuration read preserves an in-flight stdio read and allows subsequent reads on the same connection, including after a late response.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6785d5846f4c3b07a6e7c505e359238609c3a6b6

Refresh persisted capability roots from owner-provided configuration (#52676)

## Why

Resumed threads can retain stale capability root locations when the current environment supplies an explicit owner configuration. Matching roots from that configuration previously could not refresh persisted thread roots.

## What changed

Refresh persisted roots from the current attachment when both the root ID and environment ID match, including roots selected by owner-provided configuration. Preserve persisted locations when no matching root is supplied, and continue using the owner's selected roots rather than the executor's shared roots.

Apply the same merge behavior to capability root inspection and per-step resolution.

## Testing

Extend the remote environment regression test to cover owner-provided configurations with and without refreshed roots, including an executor root location that differs from the owner's selection.

GitOrigin-RevId: ad3a639924b348d6d5337ccc64dc8c08234276e3

Move the exec-server test fixture into shared test support (#52674)

## What changed

Move `ExecServerProcess` into `core_test_support::exec_server` and update the sandbox, plugin, access, and turn-input tests to use it. Preserve the fixture's startup timeout, temporary `CODEX_HOME`, WebSocket URL discovery, and child-process cleanup.

GitOrigin-RevId: 152de3a83f4ad39e2c1223e15438608dba452850

Add retention annotations to submitted tool outputs (#52671)

## What changed

Add `TurnInput::AnnotatedResponseItem` with a caller-supplied `retain` annotation. For function-call outputs, `retain: true` sets `client_authored` history metadata while keeping annotations out of model requests. Accept annotated items through the existing turn submission paths, including continuation.

## Testing

Add an integration test covering retention metadata during turn start, steering, idle submission, and rollout storage. Verify that ordinary outputs remain unmarked and model requests contain neither `retain` nor `client_authored`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7285dde31149b17b0dcf31d4ea1c7cba66d9efe6

Prevent brokered credential aliases from bypassing MITM hooks (#52661)

## Why

A credential bound to a host with MITM hooks could also be used at an alias without hooks, allowing the proxy to inject the real credential without enforcing hook policy.

## What changed

Reject requests to unhooked aliases when their selected brokered credentials are also bound to a hooked host. Check both HTTP forwarding and MITM requests before replacing dummy credentials, returning `403` with `blocked-by-mitm-hook` for denied requests.

Use the same destination and credential-selection rules for alias checks and injection, including configured URL prefixes, safe paths, equivalent credentials, merged Basic authentication fields, and environment scope.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for built-in and configured provider aliases, IPv6 destinations, credential selection, and unrelated credentials. Add an agent-started proxy test that verifies credential masking and alias denial.

GitOrigin-RevId: 12be41654761cedcf87b170f7661d6566f7a864e

Handle completion events in either order in shell snapshot tests (#52660)

## Why

A tool can return before its background watcher emits `ExecCommandEnd`. Waiting for that event first can discard an earlier `TurnComplete`, causing the shell snapshot test helper to time out.

## What changed

Update `run_tool_turn_on_harness` to track both the matching `ExecCommandEnd` and `TurnComplete` in a single event loop, returning only after both have arrived regardless of order.

GitOrigin-RevId: c9b749a46eda1244aa3e80fd88b663d110d67d1b

Add an opt-in feature for subagent model context defaults (#52659)

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `subagent_default_context_limits` feature and expose it in the configuration schema. When enabled, shared configuration for spawning and resuming subagents clears inherited `model_context_window` and `model_auto_compact_token_limit` overrides so subagents use their model's default context window and auto-compaction threshold.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5168ae2b4fbe72c533d8c6152922a8bceb2c5cbd

Bound local exec-server output draining after process exit (#52652)

## Why

A local command can exit while a descendant keeps its inherited output pipes open, delaying `exec_command` completion and turn completion.

## What changed

Start the bounded output drain when a local exec-server process exits, whether exit is reported by an event or recovered through `process/read`. Remote execution continues waiting for output closure so buffered or delayed output is retained.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for local shell snapshot execution completing before a descendant releases stdout, preserving the foreground output and exit code. Add remote event-stream cases that retain output arriving after both reported and recovered process exit.

GitOrigin-RevId: d38bcd394be42cf48d2af02733e883b02d1dd62f

Limit daemon feature compatibility checks to explicit CLI overrides (#52648)

## Why

A running shared background server owns its feature settings until it restarts. Differences from a client's configuration files or defaults should not trigger a compatibility warning or a restart request.

## What changed

- Check shared-service features only when explicitly overridden on the command line.
- Exclude overrides superseded by active legacy managed configuration or feature requirements, while supporting older servers without `configRequirements/read`.
- Pass only the remaining explicit feature overrides to a requested daemon restart.

## Testing

Update compatibility tests for stale daemon overrides, explicit enable/disable requests, managed configuration, and older servers. Extend CLI startup tests to verify the feature overrides persisted after a restart.

GitOrigin-RevId: ac92c9c02cd70fa233203ebef1182fd119325dd1

Count interrupted goal continuations toward the no-activity limit (#52640)

## Why

Interrupted automatic goal continuations reset the empty-response counter, allowing repeated interruptions without activity to keep a goal running indefinitely.

## What changed

Count interrupted automatic continuations without activity toward the existing three-turn limit that marks a goal as `blocked`. Defer evaluation until the thread is idle and serialize it with turn-start accounting. Activity and user turns still reset the counter.

## Testing

Extend accounting tests to cover interrupted and mixed empty continuations, including resets after tool activity or user turns. Add an app-server regression case where a `PreCompact` hook repeatedly interrupts automatic continuations and verify the `thread/goal/updated` notification reports `blocked`.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4c34e3ed1ae612e97cf067c2aa76836b10c50ef5

Add experimental thread item lookup by ID (#52637)

## What changed

Add `thread/items/read` to retrieve persisted items by `threadId`, `turnId`, and 1–100 `itemIds`. Return matching items in canonical stored order, omitting missing IDs and items outside the requested turn.

Add item ID filtering to the thread store while preserving inherited history and fork cutoffs. Require the experimental API capability for the new endpoint.

## Testing

Add coverage for stored ordering, turn scoping, missing IDs, request size limits, experimental capability gating, and inherited items across fork cutoffs.

GitOrigin-RevId: 9b243dd87577bd4fe36900c388a386b2e26ff2e0

Skip background workspace routing reads without ChatGPT auth (#52635)

## Why

Background workspace routing reads reload configuration even when signed out or using an API key, although routing requires ChatGPT authentication.

## What changed

Check cached authentication before reading accounts for workspace routing at app-server startup and connection initialization. Skip these background reads without ChatGPT authentication, while preserving configuration reloads for explicit `account/read` requests.

## Testing

Add regression tests covering signed-out and API-key startup and connection initialization, explicit `account/read` configuration reloads, and routing after ChatGPT sign-in, including propagation of configuration errors.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8b90ee609ed24f8618cd21f160eb7001703b8bd1

Consolidate local message board storage helpers (#52629)

## What changed

- Move the SQLite schema, database filename, and shared pool registry into `local/pool.rs`.
- Share channel insertion between runtime writes and template setup, using typed board IDs and channel descriptions.

GitOrigin-RevId: c57a79c49fe9003b3c73f38010ce9293275a714c

Add template setup for local agent message boards (#52621)

## What changed

Expose `LocalBoardSetup` and `configure_local_board` to load initial channels and optional descriptions before agents start. Add a `configure_board` example and setup documentation.

Save version 1 templates and channels atomically in SQLite. Identical templates are safe to retry; conflicting templates, previously used boards without a pinned template, and deleted boards are rejected. Setup accepts an optional creation timestamp and leaves agent access unchanged. Remove the pinned template when deleting a board.

## Testing

Add an integration test covering channel metadata after reopen, identical retries, conflicting template rejection, retries after adding a channel, and rejection after board deletion.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0b5c5439ab127fb5c275f024962a373a56635ad0

Align Linux sandbox names and docs with bubblewrap and seccomp (#52610)

## Why

The Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering, but its command type, syscall-filter module, and integration test suite still used Landlock names.

## What changed

- Rename `LandlockCommand` to `LinuxSandboxCommand`, `src/landlock.rs` to `src/seccomp.rs`, and `tests/suite/landlock.rs` to `tests/suite/sandbox.rs`, updating imports and existing tests.
- Clarify the retained legacy Landlock implementation and its filesystem-policy limitations.
- Update the README to describe existing network filtering, `AF_VSOCK` and `io_uring` restrictions, and managed-proxy Unix socket behavior, including allowed Unix socket pairs.

Sandbox enforcement behavior is unchanged.

GitOrigin-RevId: be4769d5a10b90605990eb58451e83fdf1c31222

Upgrade `hyper` to 1.11.1 and test connection closure (#52608)

## Why

Requests with `Connection: close` must not reuse the connection even when the server responds with `Connection: keep-alive`.

## What changed

Update `hyper` from 1.8.1 to 1.11.1 in `codex-rs/Cargo.lock` and add the corresponding Bazel lockfile metadata.

## Testing

Add a regression test that sends two requests with `Connection: close` to a server that ignores the header and verifies that the second request uses a new connection.

GitOrigin-RevId: 72b464c8ea3d9a1ad5d9e62f7896ea9a4f15a93c

Fix races in remote environment and session replacement tests (#52591)

## Why

The remote environment test can steer before the wait tool call is recorded, discarding the call. The session replacement test can close the client while agents overview RPCs are still pending, leaving the proxy writing to a closed socket.

## What changed

- Wait for the `wait-for-active-environment` function call event before steering the active turn.
- Wait for `AgentsOverviewThreadsLoaded` before shutting down session replacement test cases that open the agents overview.

GitOrigin-RevId: 886112a56ff6e1016efe30dbbd0256807bc1cc85

Expose message board permissions and structured denials (#52568)

## Why

Remote boards can allow replies while denying new threads. Agents need to discover these effective permissions and receive actionable details when an operation is denied.

## What changed

- Expose optional `board_permissions` and per-channel `permissions` in `get_channels`, preserving the legacy response shape when permission metadata is absent.
- Preserve HTTP 403 `permission_denied` responses as structured tool errors with a message and optional `action` and `resource`. Mark denied calls as unsuccessful and truncate oversized error details to fit the output budget.
- Pass through service-computed permissions without evaluating access rules locally.

## Testing

Add remote-board scenarios for direct tools and code mode covering legacy responses, reply-only permissions, a denied post, and a successful reply, plus a snapshot of the direct tool exchange.

GitOrigin-RevId: 76594bbc0a1283ff3c3c8682bd7615baa5ade428

Forward clipboard copies to the terminal in Herdr sessions (#52557)

## Why

Herdr sessions can gain attached clients after Codex starts. Successful native clipboard copying should still forward the text to the attached terminal, even without inherited SSH variables.

## What changed

Detect Herdr sessions with `HERDR_ENV=1` and enable terminal forwarding for `/copy` and `Ctrl+O` even when native copying succeeds. Use OSC 52 directly when outside tmux, while preserving the native copy result.

## Testing

Add a routing test verifying that a Herdr session copies natively before sending OSC 52 and retains the successful native clipboard lease.

GitOrigin-RevId: c43c08ca037ff51e902267dc8636889493f5c30c

Add opt-in history prefix preservation for full agent forks (#52535)

## What changed

Add `preserve_fork_prefix` to the multi-agent v2 configuration, defaulting to `false`. When enabled, full forks retain the parent's model-visible history, including commentary and tool records, and append the child's instructions. Legacy compaction without a reusable context baseline still rebuilds the child context.

Mark copied history as inherited, complete unfinished tool calls in the fork snapshot, and exclude inherited manual approvals from authorization review while retaining them in model context.

## Testing

Add coverage for preserved request prefixes, child instructions, legacy and paginated histories, Code Mode, missing inherited tool outputs, compaction fallback, and approval isolation across checkpoint replay. Update the noisy helper failure test to read its response before starting cleanup.

GitOrigin-RevId: ce9235dfa111c88d6ce66cb93d564fb63b326489

Avoid an extra blank quote line when pasting text with a trailing newline (#52418)

## Why

Pasting text ending in a newline into a composer line beginning with `> ` adds an unnecessary empty quoted line before the next Markdown block.

## What changed

Remove one trailing newline from nonempty blockquote paste content before adding quote prefixes. Preserve interior blank lines and the two unquoted newlines that move the cursor to the next block.

## Testing

Add a trailing-newline regression case, update the CRLF/CR expectations, and exercise trailing-newline input in the existing rendering snapshot test.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2367efa8253dd0512de8ba6333b39eba6381fba8

Add experimental app-server thread read-state updates (#52395)

## Why

Clients need to mark threads read or unread without overwriting unseen results or another window's explicit mark.

## What changed

Add `thread/readState/update` for eligible durable local threads, gated by `initialize.capabilities.experimentalApi`. Requests include `threadId`, `expectedRevision`, and an operation of `{type:"read"}` or `{type:"unread"}`.

Marking read clears `firstUnread`; marking unread sets it to `threadStart`. Successful updates return the read state and notify subscribers through `thread/readState/changed`. Both operations require an exact revision match. Stale requests return `-32600` with `readStateConflict` and the current read state, requiring a fresh user action rather than a blind retry. Updates do not change thread recency.

## Testing

Add app-server coverage for experimental capability gating, explicit unread marks and notifications, conflicts for both stale operations, and marking read with a fresh revision.

GitOrigin-RevId: 775f6e9584dc91bd3c2ee9a309144b5baf0edffa

Notify subscribers when thread read state changes (#52384)

## What changed

Add the experimental `thread/readState/changed` notification with `threadId` and the committed `readState` receipt. Send it to existing thread subscribers when terminal activity updates read state or a revert clears a removed unread position. Emit terminal read-state updates before `turn/completed` so completion remains the last notification for that result.

Expose the notification in generated JSON schemas, TypeScript types, and Python SDK models. Document experimental capability gating, subscription lifetime, notification opt-out, and refreshing receipts when concurrent responses disagree.

## Testing

Extend the read-state integration test to assert that the notification receipt matches the receipt returned by `thread/read` after terminal activity.

GitOrigin-RevId: 28935352a881b7a5e2e7f629173c3b2061bd7941

Preserve per-session routing for gRPC code mode (#52381)

## Why

Sessions sharing a transport can be admitted to different hosts. Each session needs its own routing token so subsequent RPCs reach the host holding its state.

## What changed

- Capture the optional `x-code-mode-route` metadata from successful `OpenSession` responses and attach it to subsequent session RPCs. Reject tokens longer than 256 bytes and keep new admission attempts free of existing session routes.
- Invalidate a routed session when an `Unavailable` response explicitly sets `x-code-mode-route-lost: true`, allowing a later operation to reopen it without replaying the failed execution. Ordinary `Unavailable` responses preserve the session.
- Allow up to five admission attempts for `Unavailable` and `ResourceExhausted`, with an immediate first retry followed by jittered exponential backoff.
- Order session failure with shutdown so late callback errors cannot cancel an in-flight `CloseSession` RPC.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for independent routing on a shared provider, route-loss recovery without execution replay, preservation of unaffected session state, and callback failures racing shutdown. Extend admission tests to verify the five-attempt limit and recovery tests to distinguish explicit route loss from ordinary unavailability.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5d60ef1afa56beb8c70ba7ab27865128225b0d3d

Expand realtime v3 voice support (#52363)

## Why

Realtime v3 voice validation used the v1 voice list, limiting the available voice choices.

## What changed

- Add a dedicated `v3` voice list containing the v1 voices and 16 additional voices, and use it to validate v3 requests.
- Expose `v3` in `RealtimeVoicesList`, defaulting to an empty list when omitted during deserialization.
- Update the configuration and app-server schemas, generated TypeScript and Python types, and voice-list test expectations.

GitOrigin-RevId: 7fc8060fe01d840f28eb92c3dfe49c5878c3c258

Expose experimental durable thread read state in the app server (#52350)

## What changed

- Add experimental `readState` to `thread/read` and a thread-ID-keyed `readStates` map to `thread/list` for eligible durable local user threads. Each receipt contains `firstUnread` and an opaque `revision`.
- Publish new visible terminal results before `turn/completed`, after flushing the rollout. Reading snapshots leaves activity unread; replayed history does not publish new activity.
- Clear unread positions removed by a paginated thread revert while preserving explicit thread-start marks and concurrent receipt updates.

## Testing

Add an integration test covering completed-turn receipts, repeated reads without acknowledgement, matching list receipts, and revert cleanup with a changed revision.

GitOrigin-RevId: e7f6ddfbb1fc2fa95d1ef2876d7f0f7b9f99ff65

Add durable thread read state with revision-checked updates (#52337)

## Why

A stale read acknowledgement must not clear unread results published after the client’s snapshot or overwrite another read-state edit. Read state also needs to survive thread metadata rebuilds.

## What changed

- Add `thread_read_receipts` and state APIs to query read state, publish thread attention, and mark threads read or unread.
- Track the first unread turn and require matching revisions for explicit edits, returning the current state on conflicts. Allow manually marking even an empty thread unread.
- Retain the last published turn across acknowledgements to suppress duplicate delivery. Keep receipts independent of rebuildable metadata and remove them on thread deletion.
- Return initial read states without creating receipt rows.

## Testing

Add tests covering stale edits, thread-specific initial revisions, repeated unread marks, duplicate publication, persistence across metadata rebuilds and restarts, clearing a reverted turn’s unread position, and deleted-thread handling.

GitOrigin-RevId: fee8c05c20903b1d7aea7e8b61c9248c7f623a72

Clamp wrapped source ranges before remapping terminal hyperlinks (#52330)

## Why

Wrapping can retain a cursor sentinel one byte past the end of the input. Using that range to slice source text during hyperlink remapping can panic.

## What changed

Clamp wrapped range boundaries to the input length before calculating hyperlink columns and recording logical source ranges, keeping both aligned with the visible text.

## Testing

Add a regression test that extends a wrapped range past the input boundary and verifies that the line, hyperlinks, and logical source are preserved.

GitOrigin-RevId: c83c817df8d3ea790f7d126768092ae317ff9217

Remove per-content source attribution metadata (#52329)

## What changed

- Remove `ContentItemMetadata`, provenance and namespace types, and the `content_item_metadata` protocol field while retaining `content_item_kinds` classifications.
- Simplify context fragments, extension contributions, and hook output to carry content without source attribution. Return MCP tool results directly without an attribution wrapper.
- Render context-window hints together in a single text fragment.

## Testing

Update Responses and Responses Lite request assertions to expect content-kind classifications without per-content attribution, and adapt context, hook, and extension tests to the simplified types.

GitOrigin-RevId: 201894cd4c93c6d4b4c41c845e7a9af1dd3c95ca

Track history initialization in Responses turn metadata (#52325)

## What changed

Add `history_initialization` to `x-codex-turn-metadata`, distinguishing `new`, `cleared`, `cold_resume`, `warm_fork`, `cold_fork`, and `supplied_history`.

Classify forks by whether the source runtime is loaded and has not shut down. Preserve the classification for the runtime's lifetime, including warm resumes and compaction. This records how history was initialized; it does not establish whether tool metadata is missing. Reserve the field against client-supplied overrides.

## Testing

Extend coverage for warm and cold forks, cold resumes, warm reconnects, supplied history, WebSocket metadata serialization, and reserved-field filtering.

GitOrigin-RevId: 468153512a84d0f4d4ea742198a29e0fa3873a72

Persist remote-control RPC preferences in managed daemon settings (#52304)

## Why

Durable remote-control RPC changes need to update the managed daemon's launch settings so future launches use the saved preference.

## What changed

- Save non-ephemeral `remoteControl/enable` and `remoteControl/disable` requests to `remoteControlEnabled` in `app-server-daemon/settings.json` for managed daemons.
- Preserve other settings and write updates atomically. Skip persistence when `daemon.lock` is held so concurrent lifecycle operations take precedence without blocking the RPC.
- Leave daemon settings untouched for ephemeral requests and unmanaged servers.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for durable enable and disable, ephemeral requests, and lock contention. Extend the unmanaged-server test to verify that no daemon settings file is created.

GitOrigin-RevId: 2baf261ed62f7c7ad87c9779ffb91c59e923f0f8

Add opt-in credential masking for proxied sandboxed sessions (#52302)

## What changed

- Add the disabled-by-default `features.credential_masking` flag to enable credential brokerage through an already enabled network proxy, retaining custom credential providers and managed configuration precedence.
- Prevent project configuration from overriding credential masking and apply existing credential-broker protections to project shell settings when masking is enabled.
- Keep brokerage inactive when the proxy is disabled. Warn at startup and after permission-profile changes when masking is inactive because sandboxing or the proxy is disabled, or provider environment keys conflict.

## Testing

Add coverage for configuration precedence, project protections in both configuration loaders, permission-profile transitions, inactive-masking warnings, and shell snapshot masking of built-in and custom credentials.

GitOrigin-RevId: 4bcb293356e8c1524bdaa4f1b95cbc1e935a5271

Make Bazel release jobs advisory (#52299)

## Why

Parallel Bazel artifacts are advisory while Cargo remains the release path.

## What changed

- Set `continue-on-error` for Bazel matrix jobs covering builds, Windows symbols and signing, and macOS signing, packaging, and verification.
- Assign the main release build jobs in both workflows to the `bazel` environment with `deployment: false`.

GitOrigin-RevId: e8a0fd522ec6482c0f39abdfc8677018be409361

Emit one developer notice per incremental namespace update batch (#52295)

## What changed

Move incremental tool guidance out of namespace descriptions and into a developer message preceding each namespace declaration batch after the initial catalog. The notice covers newly added namespaces as well as changed ones, explaining that earlier tools remain available unless explicitly removed and that newer definitions replace earlier ones.

Retain the notice alongside tool declarations in full-history agent forks, and discard it when legacy compaction forks rebuild those declarations.

## Testing

Add unit coverage for multiple new namespaces sharing one notice. Update request-history snapshots for tool changes, removals and restoration, and regular Responses requests. Extend resume and fork tests to cover notice preservation without duplication and removal when rebuilding declarations.

GitOrigin-RevId: 05f79f5eb378a355cf935eabf63951015a9b454b

Remove duplicate field initializers from extension registry tests (#52288)

Remove the repeated `selected_capability_roots` initializers from the two
`TurnEnvironmentSelection` fixtures in
`mcp_context_preserves_selected_executor_order_and_unavailability` so the
test can compile.

GitOrigin-RevId: 6e773cdcba84b95220eb024d51619fea67780617

Honor custom OTLP metrics exporters when analytics is disabled (#52278)

## Why

Disabling OpenAI analytics also disabled explicitly configured OTLP metrics collectors. Users should be able to export metrics to their own collectors independently of `analytics.enabled`.

## What changed

Apply the analytics preference only to the built-in `statsig` metrics exporter. Keep custom OTLP HTTP and gRPC exporters enabled regardless of that preference, and use `otel.metrics_exporter = "none"` to disable metrics export. Clarify these settings in config documentation and the schema.

## Testing

Cover exporter selection across explicit and default analytics preferences. Update app-server and daemon telemetry tests to verify custom metrics export with analytics disabled, and worktree tests to disable metrics through the exporter setting.

GitOrigin-RevId: 0c61f0f01e2b694db642ac7e7fd1dac9965c7d96

Preserve UTF-8 byte semantics in network domain matching (#52277)

## Why

Domain wildcards need to retain the byte-based behavior of `globset`. Counting Unicode scalar values changes how `?` matches non-ASCII hosts.

## What changed

Match domain patterns against UTF-8 bytes so `?` consumes exactly one byte. For example, `api??.com` matches `apié.com`. Match hosts through borrowed byte slices, avoiding the per-match character-vector allocation.

Document ASCII case insensitivity and the absence of IDNA conversion: hosts supplied as Punycode require patterns using their Punycode spelling.

## Testing

Compare Unicode wildcard cases against `globset` for both allowlists and denylists, including multibyte characters, combining marks, Punycode, and case sensitivity. Update the exhaustive dynamic-programming comparison and retry-boundary tests to operate on bytes.

GitOrigin-RevId: fae5b3b1ae60b469cd61a44c5c6e245730adc8ba

Add structured tracing for Guardian reviews and background scoring (#52274)

## What changed

- Add debug spans with review, thread, turn, and tool-call identifiers to correlate approval reviews and background scoring.
- Log review retry scheduling with failure details, attempt limits, backoff, and remaining deadline budget.
- Emit warnings for Guardian V2 background scoring failures with the failure reason, context mode, and duration, even when metrics are unavailable.

GitOrigin-RevId: 3e20d16836576f834998af473815bfb55e671de5

Add configurable persistent leader shortcuts to the TUI (#52273)

## What changed

- Add `tui.keymap.global.leader`, defaulting to `ctrl-x`, and symbolic bindings such as `leader c` that follow the configured prefix. The default prefix yields to existing custom shortcuts and chord prefixes.
- Keep leader shortcut hints open until completion or cancellation, while ordinary chords retain their one-second timeout. Pressing `esc` or repeating the leader cancels the pending shortcut.
- Add leader configuration and a `Use leader...` capture option to `/keymap`, with resolved shortcut labels and conflict validation.
- Cancel pending chords when input targets change, on paste or focus loss, and on mouse actions other than movement.
- Move the default voice mute shortcut from `ctrl-x` to `f9` and update its tests and displayed hints.

GitOrigin-RevId: 35b964cccd2812c73200f0c26b0f19506821df92

Enable text selection in the fullscreen TUI footer (#52270)

## What changed

Allow mouse selection and plain-text copying of rendered status and footer text, honoring `tui.copy_on_select` and existing selection keyboard controls. Keep the selected region stable while other content updates, preserve Unicode and terminal hyperlinks, and clear selections when their region becomes invalid.

Defer warning clicks until a stationary mouse release so dragging selects text without opening the warning viewer. Preserve the composer draft and cursor while selecting footer text.

## Testing

Add unit and snapshot coverage for visible-text copying, Unicode and hyperlinks, selection invalidation, keyboard ownership, and stationary clicks versus drags. Add a fullscreen integration test for warning selection and draft preservation.

GitOrigin-RevId: dd14d7ede52e97e507be24c4d6ac0299f7388a9b

Preserve large arguments in executed tool call metadata (#52268)

## Why

Fixed argument limits truncated recorded tool calls even when their metadata fit within the available message budget.

## What changed

- Remove the 8 KiB per-call and 32 KiB per-output argument limits for direct calls and Code Mode.
- Preserve full recorded arguments while retaining message metadata budgets, pending-call limits, and the direct metadata retention limit.
- Rename the normalization helper to `normalize_executed_tool_call_completeness`; it now only clears completeness when calls or tool names were lost.

## Testing

Update regression coverage for large arguments, escaped inputs, reserved-key wrappers, and argument and result metadata preservation across Code Mode waits.

GitOrigin-RevId: 8c199ccf39191d5d44eef02d28b1773654735b43

Normalize formatting in docs, web assets, and sample scripts (#52256)

## What changed

- Reformat Markdown tables and lists, login pages, inline visualization HTML, and sample JavaScript scripts.

Add experimental prediction forks that inherit parent context (#51884)

## Why

Prediction forks need to preserve the parent's effective context and request settings to maximize prompt-cache reuse.

## What changed

- Add `experimentalPredictionMode` to `thread/fork` for ephemeral forks of loaded, persisted parents. Reject configuration overrides, `path`, `lastTurnId`, and `beforeTurnId` in this mode.
- Inherit the parent's effective configuration, tools, environments, collaboration settings, disabled plugins, and persisted history.
- Enable `features.reasoning_effort_override` on the fork while preserving the parent's request-effort baseline, including when overrides were disabled on the parent.
- Report the fork's effective model, service tier, and reasoning effort in the response.

## Testing

Add coverage for matching parent and fork requests and prompt-cache keys across legacy and paginated history, invalid fork parameters, and reasoning-effort inheritance. Add a context snapshot for identical parent and fork continuations.

Keep global app-server config independent of the launch directory (#51872)

## Why

Global requests can inherit project settings from the app-server's launch directory. This can prevent marketplace removal or expose project-only feature settings, and config reloads can fail if that directory is deleted.

## What changed

- Load configuration without project context when no working directory is supplied, using `CODEX_HOME` to materialize `Config.cwd`.
- Use global configuration for marketplace mutations, marketplace upgrade reloads, and MCP requests without thread context.
- Pass the launch directory explicitly during startup to preserve project-aware startup configuration.

## Testing

Update regression tests to verify that marketplace removal ignores launch-project configuration and leaves the project config intact. Extend feature-list coverage to verify that global requests ignore project features, thread requests retain them, and global requests work after the launch directory is deleted on Unix.

## Why

Add naming tests for accepted display names and fallback cases, a composer snapshot verifying `@Postman` and its plugin binding, and a submission regression test for a plugin and skill sharing the name `foo`.

Align Bazel release builds with Cargo and fix platform compatibility (#51848)

## Why

Bazel release builds need Cargo-compatible Rust and native build-script settings. Platform-specific issues also include Windows command-line limits, MSVC runtime conflicts with V8's allocator, and a missing V8 `__clear_cache` symbol on ARM64 musl.

## What changed

- Add `--config=release` settings for thin LTO, four target codegen units, and disabled debug assertions and overflow checks, with separate settings for build tools.
- Add opt-in Cargo release profile support for build-script optimization and debug information, preserving explicit C/C++ flags. Give optimized Bubblewrap builds `-O3`, debug symbols, and enabled native assertions.
- Statically link the MSVC CRT for Rust and C/C++ target and host dependencies, and disable SQLite intrinsics on x64 MSVC to avoid startup crashes on older CPUs.
- Let the Rust process wrapper read its arguments from a multiline parameter file to avoid Windows command-line limits.
- Select the ARM64 musl V8 archive containing compiler-rt builtins and raise the Rust recursion limit to `256` in the app-server client, exec, and TUI entry points for release compilation.
